newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks may fall on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks may fall on profit taking.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may fall marginally amid profit taking when trading resumes on Saturday after the Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.
"The scrips which gained during the previous three sessions may slip marginally on profit taking. There may be more sellers than buyers," said Golam Sarwar of Mahbub Morshed and Company.
The DSE all-share price index closed 46 points or 2.37 percent up at 1,979.67 on a turnover of 97.5 million taka on Thursday.
